purpose: Persist authenticated read-only recovery plan submissions and derive all prior submitters and declared coauthors from the complete signed lineage.
integration: A new preparer method calls the journal only after its own original-session, full-source, complete SQL/root, current identity and two actual workflow captures have succeeded, inside its already-held control SQLite transaction.
storage: Dedicated bounded journal table and signed sibling details.planJournal anchor in the original control SQLite; SOURCE_V3, fullFacts, details.review and its first result remain unchanged.
recordAuthentication: Canonical records and anchor use separate HMAC domains derived from the original private credential key, bound to control/source/recovery/intent/credential hashes. Verify every revision, parent, original observation file and complete contributor lineage.
submissionRules: Caller supplies only a plan UUID, expected parent hash, original session and current participant tokens; caller actor records, approval flags and callbacks are invalid.
Every new author is a real current submission actor. The union of prior submitters and all declared coauthors must be present in the freshly authenticated current cohort.
The independently observed reviewer cannot be any contributor. Submission records an intended reviewer without granting approval.

Same head plan UUID, original expected parent and identical semantic inputs/participants may replay after fresh verification without a new revision; changed replay actors, stale parent or superseded IDs reject.
Maximum64 plans and128KiB per record, complete history, no filtering or truncation. Plan lifetime30min; fresh submission evidence retains the unchanged30sec identity window.
All journal rows and anchor changes are in the caller's existing transaction. A rollback must leave neither a plan nor a changed anchor. Process reopen reauthenticates stored history.
verification: Real temporary SQLite persistence, rollback and process reopen unit tests; these tests validate the persistence contract and do not authenticate real users.
Reject altered signatures, parent/revision/schema/source binding, missing or changed original evidence, omitted contributor, reviewer conflict and replay mismatch.
New coordinator entry rejects forged sessions and injected authorization before opening a state store.
Full native real OIDC/Flowable and complete restore integration is required before publication or a live identity completion claim.
